skill.displayName: TV Program Preview - 电视节目预告

version.changelog:
Version 1.0.3

- Updated SKILL.md for improved clarity and completeness, including a friendlier introduction and detailed configuration steps.
- Enhanced documentation of pre-requisites, use cases, and error handling.
- Expanded the description of "极速数据" and its other API offerings at the end of the documentation.
- No code changes; this update only affects documentation and user instructions.

llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward TV schedule lookup that uses a documented third-party API key and sends channel/date queries to the advertised TV data provider.

dimensions.detail: Outbound API access and the JISU_API_KEY are proportionate to querying JisuAPI; the request sends the API key plus tvid/date parameters and uses a fixed provider URL.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer or mutation logic is present; the skill documents a Python runtime and a user-provided JISU_API_KEY environment variable.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger language includes a broad 'similar TV program questions' phrase, but examples and implementation remain limited to channel/date TV schedule lookups.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background execution, local indexing, destructive operations, or credential-store access were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is TV channel and schedule lookup, and the bundled script only supports channel listing and schedule query operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable creating a JisuAPI account and letting this skill send your JISU_API_KEY plus TV channel/date query details to JisuAPI. Keep the API key scoped to this service and rotate it if it is exposed.
llm.findings:
[TP2] expected: The mixed scripts are part of a bilingual English/Chinese display name and Chinese documentation, not a visually spoofed tool identifier.
[LP3] expected: The skill does require an env API key and network access, but both are disclosed and aligned with the TV API purpose.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad routing phrase is imprecise, but the described and implemented behavior remains bounded to TV program questions.
[E1] expected: The external transmission is to the documented JisuAPI TV endpoint and carries only the app key and TV schedule query parameters.
[SQP-2] expected: The exact request line has no runtime prompt, but SKILL.md prominently documents JisuAPI as the data source and setup provider.
